name: burnzombies
description: Computer-wide observation and guarded cleanup of abandoned agent helpers on macOS.
long_description: Computer-wide process evidence, guarded graceful stops and verified impact through MCP. Use the single-command installer to enable the independent background observer and its selected harness reviewer; this MCP bundle alone provides interactive tools. Native macOS 14+, Apple Silicon/Intel. Ad-hoc signed, not notarized.

tools.name: burnzombies_status
tools.description: Read process-family counts, pressure and receipts.

tools.name: burnzombies_preview
tools.description: Preview agent-selected identities with ownership rationale.

tools.name: burnzombies_burn
tools.description: Request guarded SIGTERM for a fresh preview.

tools.name: burnzombies_checkpoint
tools.description: Quiet cached-signal lifecycle callback; never stops processes.

tools.name: burnzombies_lifecycle
tools.description: Remember active helper ownership and owner-observed completion; never stops a process.

tools.name: burnzombies_work
tools.description: Read durable lifecycle evidence across tasks without exposing ownership tokens.
